transcript.answer: Otto's own frame recorder (`apps/api/src/testing/recordWsFrames.ts`) and its fixture (`hal-frames.json`) were removed in issue #181, in commit 8834b9ba, dated 2026-10-21. They were replaced by `recordedFrames`, which HAL Engine 0.10.0 exports and re-records in its own CI. `@re-cinq/hal-engine` was added as a devDependency of `apps/web`, and the replay tests now assign those frames to the local protocol union without a cast. The CI step that re-ran the recorder was also deleted. The replay now serves as the drift gate the recorder used to be.
